We are a leading trading platform expanding to the four corners of the globe. Our top-rated products have won prestigious industry awards for their cutting-edge technology and seamless client experience. We deliver only the best, so we are always in search of the best people to join our ever-growing team.
We're looking for an experienced IAM Specialist to help keep access across our systems secure, efficient, and compliant. You'll sit where operations, security, and audit meet: tightening permissions, reducing risk, and supporting our access governance work. You'll work hands-on with tools like AWS, Okta, and Google Workspace, help extend our IAM practices into infrastructure and compliance, and use automation to replace manual access processes.
